root_cause.github_cli_https_git_credential_prompt_y: Adds workflow scope when Git credential integration is selected; if the configured helper is already gh, workflow may be added without prompting.
root_cause.production_path_authenticated_surface: Fixed gh api calls after OAuth; external Git checkout occurs before OAuth and later Git operations are local verification/read operations.

remediation_scope.principle: Do not opt into Git credential integration for this Phase-C OAuth token. Preserve the minimum OAuth scope request and require the canonical effective-scope exact gate to decide whether the token is acceptable.

exact_v9_override.step2_oauth_command_unchanged: GH_BROWSER='/bin/true' gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web --scopes 'repo,read:org,gist'
step2_operator_ui_contract_replacement: The GitHub CLI prompt `Authenticate Git with your GitHub credentials? (Y/n)` MUST be visibly presented before the one-time device code. Answer No.

If that Git credential prompt is absent, bypassed, materially different, or the flow reaches a device code without first receiving the explicit No decision, STOP before device authorization, delete the Codespace, and return for review. No retry in that session.

After answering No, when the CLI displays the one-time device code and asks to open the browser, press Enter. GH_BROWSER=/bin/true intentionally prevents an in-terminal/text browser from opening while allowing gh to enter its device-flow wait/poll path.
Complete https://github.com/login/device in a first-party iPhone GitHub UI. Do not enter GitHub username/password into a terminal or text browser and do not expose the one-time code to Core/chat.

Return to the same dedicated Codespace after GitHub reports the device is connected. Do not run a repository command from the returned ordinary shell. Immediately perform the already reviewed post-OAuth clean-shell reentry, trusted-Python gate, Step 2.6 rehydrate/reverify, and nonmutating Step 3 sequence.
exact_v9_override.post_oauth_chain: v4 Step 2.5 clean-shell reentry, v8 trusted-Python preloader gate, v4/v7 Step 2.6 transport/rehydrate/reverify, and the reviewed nonmutating Step-3 diagnostic are unchanged.

consolidated_review_unit.unit: OAuth command + mandatory Git-credential prompt presence + No decision + device OAuth + post-OAuth clean-shell reentry + trusted-Python gate + Step 2.6 rehydrate/reverify + canonical effective-scope check + nonmutating Step 3
consolidated_review_unit.review_goal: Find every statically discoverable incompatibility in this affected chain before any future live session; do not split into one-defect micro reviews.
